name: deposit-service
description: Owns deposit accounts and everything around them. Opens a ledger account per deposit account, drives daily interest accrual and capitalisation, fee charging, overdrafts, term deposits, pots, sweeps, standing orders, dormancy and closure. Never changes balances itself; it posts through the ledger.

name: statement-service
description: Generates account statements (PDF, CSV, camt.053, MT940, OFX) per cycle or on demand from ledger data, delivers them by email, in-app, post or SFTP, and produces interest and tax certificates.

name: card-service
description: Card programs, card products, card lifecycle (issue, activate, freeze, replace, close), physical card orders through bureaus, card controls and spend limits, PIN events and credit card statement cycles.

name: card-vault-service
description: PCI DSS scoped card data vault. Stores PAN, CVV2 and expiry encrypted with envelope encryption under HSM-managed keys and returns tokens. Isolated network segment; only authorisation, tokenisation and reveal flows may detokenise.

name: card-authorization-service
description: Real-time authorisation: receives ISO 8583 from the card gateway, applies card status, controls, limits, fraud score and 3DS outcome, places or increments the ledger hold (or calls JIT funding), and responds within the scheme budget. Runs stand-in when the ledger is unavailable.

name: card-tokenization-service
description: Network tokenisation through scheme token services (VTS, MDES) for Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay and merchant card-on-file, including provisioning decisions, step-up (OTP / app) and lifecycle sync.

name: card-threeds-service
description: 3-D Secure 2.x access control server (ACS) integration: risk-based frictionless decisions, challenges via OTP, app push or biometrics, and decoupled authentication.

name: card-clearing-service
description: Imports scheme clearing files (Visa BASE II, Mastercard IPM/T112), matches presentments to authorisations, posts final amounts to the ledger, computes interchange and fees, and tracks scheme settlement positions.

name: card-dispute-service
description: Cardholder disputes and scheme chargebacks (Visa Resolve Online, Mastercom): intake, provisional credit, evidence, deadlines per stage, representment handling and final outcome postings.

name: rewards-service
description: Loyalty programs: earn rules on spend and behaviour, points accounts with an append-only points ledger, cashback, tiers, a redemption catalogue, and referral programs with qualification and payouts.

name: insights-service
description: Personal finance management: transaction enrichment (clean merchant names, logos, categories, geo, recurring flags), category taxonomy and customer overrides, budgets, subscription detection, insight cards and cash-flow forecasts.

name: campaign-service
description: Targeted marketing campaigns across channels with A/B variants, schedules and budgets; personalised offers (pre-approved loans, card upgrades, rate promotions) with eligibility, consent checks and response tracking.

name: inbox-service
description: Secure, authenticated two-way messaging between customers and the bank with attachments and read receipts, plus in-app announcements and banners.

name: ledger-service
description: Posting engine and balance service. The only component allowed to change balances. Enforces double-entry, idempotency, holds and available-balance rules; publishes every posting.

name: gl-service
description: Chart of accounts per legal entity, product-to-GL mapping, real-time GL aggregation from ledger events, accounting periods and continuous close, trial balance, IFRS 9 provisions and ERP export.

name: reconciliation-service
description: Imports external statements and settlement files, matches them against internal ledger records with configurable rules (and AI suggestions), and manages breaks in ageing exception queues.

name: loan-origination-service
description: Loan and credit-line applications from any channel: applicants, declared finances, documents, credit bureau pulls, scorecards with explainable reason codes, affordability, decisions, offers and e-signature.

name: loan-service
description: Loan and credit-line servicing: disbursement, schedules, daily accrual, repayment allocation waterfall, fees, rate changes, restructuring, prepayment, delinquency (DPD) tracking, write-off and recovery. All money movements are posted through ledger-service.

name: collateral-service
description: Collateral registry: pledged assets and guarantees, valuations, links to exposures with LTV, insurance policies and release / liquidation.

name: collections-service
description: Collections and recovery for loans, credit lines, cards, overdrafts and BNPL: strategies by segment and DPD, automated contact actions, agent queues, promises to pay, payment plans, AI next-best-action and legal proceedings.

name: openbanking-service
description: ASPSP open banking gateway. Validates TPP identity (eIDAS / directory certificates), manages consents and SCA redirect / decoupled flows, enforces consent scope on every call, and translates standard profiles to internal account, payment and funds-check APIs.

name: business-day-service
domain_title: Operations: Batch, Files, Search and Archive
description: Owns the business date per legal entity, orchestrates EOD/EOM/EOQ/EOY job graphs with dependencies, parallelism, retries and restart-from-failure, performs the date roll, and schedules non-EOD batch jobs with distributed locks. Jobs execute in the owning services; this service coordinates them (Temporal).

name: file-gateway-service
domain_title: Operations: Batch, Files, Search and Archive
description: Managed file transfer with banks, schemes, bureaus, regulators and partners over SFTP, FTPS, S3, AS2 and APIs: PGP encryption, virus scanning, format validation, routing of inbound files to consumer services, generation and delivery of outbound files, acknowledgements and a complete transfer audit trail.

name: search-service
domain_title: Operations: Batch, Files, Search and Archive
description: Enterprise search across customers, accounts, wallets, cards, loans, payments and cases. Maintains OpenSearch indices fed by domain events (CDC), with versioned mappings, zero-downtime reindexing via alias swaps, synonyms, field-level masking by role, and saved searches per user.

name: archive-service
domain_title: Operations: Batch, Files, Search and Archive
description: Data lifecycle management: data classification catalogue, retention policies per data class and jurisdiction, archival of aged records to immutable object storage with manifests, legal holds that override retention, anonymisation, and approved purges with certificates of destruction.

name: customer-service
description: Customer information file (CIF): individuals and businesses, identifiers, addresses, contacts, relationships and UBOs, groups and households, segments, KYC tier, devices, credentials, consent and privacy requests. Provides the single customer view across all products.

name: onboarding-service
description: No-code onboarding journeys per product, segment and country; runs applications step by step across app, web, USSD, agent and branch channels, orchestrates KYC checks and decisions, and syncs offline agent-assisted applications.

name: kyc-service
description: KYC/KYB orchestration: document capture and OCR, liveness and face match, database and registry checks, UBO discovery, PEP/sanctions/adverse-media screening at onboarding, risk rating with factors, periodic review and document-expiry refresh, all through pluggable providers.

name: payment-service
description: Payment orchestrator. Owns the payment lifecycle state machine (initiate, screen, approve, hold funds, route, submit, settle, return), payees and aliases, bulk payments, mandates, collections, request-to-pay, payment links and QR codes. Runs multi-step flows as Temporal sagas with compensations.

name: routing-service
description: Rail catalogue and adapters, cut-offs and calendars, smart routing (cost, speed, success rate), raw rail message store, settlement batches, nostro accounts and intraday liquidity positions.

name: fx-service
description: FX quotes with expiry and margin, FX deal booking, remittance corridors with partner routing and payout methods, and remittance partner configuration.

name: tenant-service
description: Tenant lifecycle and placement on cells, legal entities, branches, per-tenant settings, feature flags, enabled modules and white-label branding.

name: identity-service
description: Staff and operator identity: users, roles, permissions, ABAC policies, SSO (OIDC/SAML), MFA, sessions; and machine identity: OAuth 2.1 API clients, API keys, scopes, rate-limit policies and request logs. Customer credentials and device binding live in the party domain.

name: config-service
description: Versioned, approval-gated configuration promoted across environments, country packs (regulatory reports, tax rules, holidays, schemes per jurisdiction) and tax rules.

name: reference-data-service
description: Golden source of reference data: currencies, countries, languages, business and rail calendars, FX rates and their sources, bank directory (BIC / national clearing codes), MCC and ISO 20022 purpose codes.

name: document-service
description: Encrypted document storage with virus scanning, classification and retention / legal hold; templates and document generation (statements, contracts, letters); electronic signatures.

name: workflow-service
description: Maker-checker approvals for configuration and sensitive operations (multi-level, amount thresholds, segregation of duties), workflow definitions and instances on Temporal, and human work queues with SLAs.

name: notification-service
description: Event-driven multi-channel notifications (push, SMS, email, WhatsApp, in-app, USSD, voice) with localised templates, provider failover, delivery tracking, preferences and quiet hours.

name: webhook-service
description: Delivers domain events to client endpoints: signed (HMAC-SHA256 + timestamp), at-least-once with exponential retries for 72 hours, ordering per aggregate, delivery logs and event replay.

name: audit-service
description: Tamper-evident, hash-chained audit log of every user, API and system action, retained per jurisdiction (10 years minimum), with regulator / DSAR exports under maker-checker.

name: billing-service
description: SaaS commercial engine: price plans, tenant subscriptions, usage metering from platform events, and monthly invoicing with usage tiers.

name: product-catalog-service
description: Product Studio back end. Holds templates, products and immutable published versions with all parameters (interest, fees, tax, limits, eligibility, scripts). Accounts pin a version; publishing goes through maker-checker; simulations run a product against synthetic customers.

name: pricing-rules-service
description: DMN-compatible decision engine used for pricing, eligibility, fees, limits and routing decisions. Decision tables are versioned with maker-checker; every evaluation is logged for explainability.

name: regulatory-reporting-service
description: Catalogue of regulatory reports per country pack with versioned templates and data mappings; runs reports reproducibly from source snapshots, validates them, tracks manual adjustments and submits to regulators with acknowledgements. Also builds CRS and FATCA records.

name: analytics-service
description: Self-service analytics over whitelisted datasets: governed KPI catalogue with SQL-free metric specs, dashboards and widgets embedded in the console, saved queries in a safe query DSL, exports and scheduled data shares to the tenant's warehouse or bucket.

name: ai-platform-service
description: Model registry with model risk management (validation, bias tests, explainability, approval), deployments in shadow/canary/champion-challenger with monitoring, feature catalogue, copilot definitions, an immutable audit of every copilot interaction, and LLM gateway policies.

name: fraud-service
description: Scores every authorisation, payment, wallet transfer, login and profile change in under 50 ms with rules (CEL expressions) plus ML models, maintains device intelligence and block/allow lists, raises fraud alerts and collects outcome labels for model training.

name: transaction-monitoring-service
description: Streaming (Flink) and batch AML transaction monitoring scenarios with versioned thresholds, alerts with contributing transactions, customer AML risk rating, and an entity graph for mule and network detection.

name: sanctions-service
description: Loads and versions sanctions, PEP and adverse-media lists; screens customers, related parties and payments with fuzzy name matching (transliteration, phonetic, token) and manages good-guy whitelists.

name: case-management-service
description: Investigation workspace for AML, fraud and sanctions cases: consolidates alerts, evidence, notes and tasks; records dispositions with maker-checker; drafts and files SAR/STR reports (goAML export).

name: limits-service
description: Central limits engine: amount, count and balance limits by scope (tier, product, customer, account, card, wallet, agent), channel, transaction type and period; atomic check-and-reserve with commit or release, temporary overrides with approval, and risk appetite metrics.

name: crm-service
description: Cases, complaints, interactions, notes, work queues and SLAs for servicing staff, plus the knowledge base and the servicing copilot. Builds the customer timeline from its own records and from events of other domains.

name: treasury-deal-service
description: Front and middle office for treasury: counterparties and limits, money market, FX and securities deals, confirmations (MT300/MT320) and settlement instructions; posts to the ledger on settlement, accrual and maturity, and releases payment instructions through payment-service.

name: liquidity-service
description: Real-time and projected cash positions by currency and nostro, maturity ladders, Basel III LCR and NSFR calculations, intraday liquidity monitoring and liquidity stress testing.

name: alm-service
description: Interest rate risk in the banking book: repricing gap, NII and EVE sensitivity under rate shocks, behavioural assumptions, and funds transfer pricing curves and assignments.

name: wallet-service
description: Wallet lifecycle, KYC-tier limits, PINs, linked bank accounts and every wallet money movement (P2P, cash-in/out, merchant, bill, airtime, G2P, wallet-to-bank, reversals). Each transaction is broken into legs and posted atomically to the ledger.

name: agent-network-service
description: Agent hierarchy (super-agent, agent, sub-agent), outlets with geo-location, territories, float management and rebalancing, tills and cash counts, agent devices / POS, agent KYB documents, cash-in-transit requests and daily performance.

name: commission-service
description: Multi-level commission engine: versioned plans with rules by transaction type, channel, tier, agent level, territory and biller; real-time accrual on every completed transaction; periodic or real-time payout runs to commission wallets with tax withholding.

name: biller-service
description: Biller catalogue (utilities, telecom, TV, government, education), airtime and bundle products, bill inquiry and validation, bill payments and airtime top-ups with provider integration and retries, and periodic settlement to billers.

name: merchant-service
description: Merchant onboarding and acceptance: stores, terminals, EMVCo static/dynamic QR codes and payment links; merchant discount rate fee plans; periodic settlement to wallet or bank; refunds.

name: channel-service
description: USSD and SMS channels for feature phones: per-tenant, per-language menu trees with versioning and a simulator, MNO gateway callbacks and session state, SMS keyword commands, and an SMS log.

name: disbursement-service
description: Government-to-person, payroll, social-transfer and humanitarian bulk disbursements: programs with funding wallets, batch upload, beneficiary validation (wallet exists, name match, tier, duplicates), multi-level approval, execution with retries and reporting.

name: interop-service
description: Interoperability with national switches, Mojaloop hubs and partner wallets/banks: participant directory, party lookup, quotes, two-phase transfers (reserve, commit, abort) with liquidity and net-debit-cap control, and inbound callbacks.
